name: Fudo Tetra Corporation
summary: Fudo Tetra Corporation engages in the civil engineering, ground improvement, and blocks and environment businesses in Japan. The company undertakes land civil engineering works, including roads, railways, dams, rivers, water supply and sewage, and energy facilities; and marine civil engineering works, such as ports, airports, fishing ports, coastlines, and artificial islands, as well as offers environmental solutions. It also provides settlement reduction, stability increase, liquefaction mitigation, cut-off wall, building foundation, and other ground improvement technologies.
